### About the Project

This project, **Apex Project: Team Plotmasters**, focuses on Customer Segmentation analysis using the Blinkit Orders dataset for the fulfillment of partial credit requirements.

### The notebook
The analysis includes:  
- Data Cleaning and Validation  
- Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)  
- Feature Engineering  
- Clustering and Modelling
